jobs.title: Director, Global Technology & Operations Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
The Director, Global Technology \& Operations Strategy \& Transformation will help shape and execute strategic priorities across Global Technology \& Operations (GTO), with a significant focus on leading the AI program and translating strategy into measurable business outcomes.

  



The Director will lead the AI program across GTO, bringing together strategy, business case development, funding, program governance, technical delivery, adoption, and value realization. This includes managing AI program funding, ensuring funding is directed to the appropriate initiatives and teams, and maintaining visibility into how initiatives are progressing against delivery commitments, defined success criteria, and approved budgets.

  



Working closely with the VP of GTO and senior stakeholders across Business, Technology, Enterprise AI, Finance, and Risk, the Director will provide an integrated view of the AI program, drive accountability across teams, identify areas requiring leadership attention, and enable informed decisions on priorities, funding, execution, and outcomes.

  



The Director will also help shape how GTO delivers its AI agenda, establishing approaches to prioritize and sequence initiatives, accelerate execution, and scale reusable AI capabilities across segments and countries. This includes helping establish a practical path from opportunity identification through development, production, and adoption, while focusing resources on initiatives that can deliver the greatest strategic and business impact.

  

  

**Position Responsibilities**
-----------------------------


* **GTO Strategy \& Transformation:** Partner with the VP of GTO and senior leaders to translate strategic priorities into executable strategies, roadmaps, initiatives, and measurable outcomes. Connect priorities across teams, identify opportunities and risks, and provide insights and recommendations to support executive decision\-making.
* **AI Program Leadership \& Governance:** Lead the end\-to\-end AI and Automation program across GTO, establishing a single integrated view of initiatives, priorities, dependencies, funding, and outcomes. Establish program governance and operating rhythms and work across Product Owners, Segment Leads, Technology, and business and functional partners to drive execution, alignment, and accountability.
* **AI Strategy, Prioritization \& Delivery Approach:** Help define how GTO identifies, assesses, prioritizes, sequences, and delivers AI initiatives. Develop practical prioritization and delivery approaches that consider strategic alignment, business value, delivery readiness, scalability, complexity, funding requirements, dependencies, and risk. Continuously assess the portfolio to ensure resources remain focused on the highest\-value opportunities and identify where initiatives should be accelerated, repositioned, or deprioritized.
* **Business Case \& AI Program Funding:** Lead the planning, mobilization, and partner engagement required to develop business cases for AI execution and future funding, including cost\-benefit analysis, expected outcomes, success criteria, delivery requirements, and risk considerations. Manage AI program funding and recommend allocation or reallocation across initiatives and teams based on strategic priorities, expected value, delivery readiness, and performance.
* **Delivery Excellence, Performance \& Value Realization:** Oversee AI initiatives across technical delivery, business outcomes, adoption, success criteria, budget utilization, risks, and dependencies. Assess whether initiatives are delivering against their original commitments, drive accountability for results, and identify where intervention, reprioritization, or funding adjustments are required. Ensure realized outcomes can be traced back to approved business cases and defined success measures.
* **Executive Reporting \& Stakeholder Management:** Provide the VP of GTO and senior leadership with a consolidated view of the AI program, including roadmap progress, funding utilization, delivery performance, value realization, risks, dependencies, and decisions required. Maintain effective engagement across sponsors, segments, Technology, Enterprise AI, Finance, Risk, and other partners, translating complex information into clear executive insights and recommendations.
* **AI\-Driven Transformation \& Reusable Capabilities:** Identify opportunities to fundamentally redesign processes and ways of working through AI and Automation, moving beyond incremental improvements. Drive the development, reuse, and adoption of scalable AI capabilities, standards, playbooks, and common approaches that accelerate delivery and reduce duplication across GTO.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* 8\+ years of experience across strategy and transformation, technology, AI, program management, product management, or related disciplines, with demonstrated experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs.
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale AI, Automation, technology, innovation, or transformation programs, including program governance, prioritization, funding, delivery oversight, and performance management.
* Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with demonstrated experience translating strategy into prioritized programs, roadmaps, business cases, funding recommendations, and measurable outcomes.

jobs.company: Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario (FSRA)
jobs.title: Director, Transformation & Regulatory Modernization
jobs.description:
At FSRA, our vision is to ensure financial safety, fairness, and choice for Ontarians. As a financial services regulator, we’re passionate about protecting consumers. Our principles\-based approach means we can quickly and effectively respond to the changing needs of consumers and the industry.

  

Our team combines industry expertise with commitment to public service. We attract individuals who are interested in meaningful work and who measure success through outcomes, not inputs.

  

At FSRA, we invest in the personal and professional growth of our team. We offer a competitive compensation package that includes an employer\-matched defined benefit pension plan, and a comprehensive and competitive benefits plan. We prioritize learning and development, wellbeing, diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging, and community giving.

  

Join FSRA and help us shape the future of regulation for generations to come!

**Job Description:**

**Hiring Range:** *$149,00\-$199,00 (hiring range and will be determined based on the successful candidate's qualifications, skills, and relevant experience)*

 **PURPOSE OF POSITION**


To provide strategic leadership, business ownership, and program direction for FSRA’s Property \& Casualty Auto Transformation Program, a multi\-year initiative to modernize auto insurance regulation through the implementation of a new supervisory technology platform and future\-state operating model.

  

The position leads the design, implementation, change management, benefits realization, and operational transition required to enable FSRA’s future Auto Insurance Supervisory Model, including insurer accreditation, risk\-based supervision, advanced analytics, streamlined regulatory processes, and enhanced market oversight. Working collaboratively with internal business areas, technology partners, system integrators, insurers, and other stakeholders, the position supports FSRA’s broader modernization agenda by advancing innovative, data\-driven, automated, and sustainable supervisory approaches that strengthen regulatory effectiveness and improve consumer outcomes in Ontario.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

 **Auto Transformation Program Leadership**

* Lead the delivery of FSRA's Auto Transformation Program, ensuring successful implementation of the new supervisory technology platform, associated business processes, and future\-state operating model.
* Establish and maintain program governance, executive reporting, performance measures, and oversight mechanisms to support successful delivery.
* Manage program scope, budget, timelines, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements while ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and approved business outcomes.
* Lead implementation planning, readiness assessments, operational transition activities, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Provide strategic advice and recommendations to senior leadership on program direction, delivery risks, and transformation opportunities.

 **Supervisory Modernization and Business Transformation**

* Lead the design of the future\-state supervisory operating model supporting risk\-based regulation and insurer accreditation.
* Work across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, and technology teams to redesign business processes and improve regulatory effectiveness.
* Ensure the transformation supports enhanced supervisory capabilities, proactive oversight, market intelligence, and consumer outcome monitoring.
* Drive process simplification, automation, standardization, and continuous improvement across regulatory operations.

 **Technology Enablement and Innovation**

* Partner with Information Technology, vendors, and system integrators to ensure business requirements are effectively translated into technology solutions.
* Champion the use of automation, artificial intelligence, workflow technologies, and advanced analytics to improve supervisory effectiveness and efficiency.
* Guide development of capabilities including risk\-based filing triage and decisioning, regulatory workflow and case management, supervisory analytics and market intelligence, AI\-assisted supervision, digital insurer experience and self\-service functionality and enterprise reporting and regulatory intelligence capabilities.

 **Stakeholder Engagement and Change Leadership**

* Serve as the primary business lead for stakeholder engagement related to the transformation program.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with insurers, industry associations, technology partners, and other stakeholders.
* Lead organizational change management, communications, training, and adoption activities required to support successful implementation.
* Represent FSRA at industry forums, conferences, working groups, and stakeholder engagements related to regulatory modernization and supervisory transformation.

 **Benefits Realization and Business Performance**

* Monitor achievement of expected outcomes, including reduced filing review cycle times, increased supervisory capacity, improved stakeholder experience, enhanced regulatory intelligence, greater operational efficiency and improved market oversight capabilities.
* Establish and maintain a comprehensive governance and performance management framework, including KPI tracking, outcome measurement, benefits realization, and executive reporting, to ensure delivery of strategic objectives and sustainable transformation outcomes

 **Leadership and People Management**

* Lead and develop a team responsible for transformation delivery, business modernization, and strategic initiatives.
* Foster collaboration across supervision, actuarial, policy, legal, operations, data, and technology teams.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of FSRA's Auto Insurance Supervisory Model and broader regulatory modernization efforts.
* Champion innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and evidence\-based decision\-making.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

* University degre

jobs.title: Director of Marketing & Digital Commerce
jobs.description:
**Director of Marketing \& Digital Commerce**

**BARBECUES GALORE \| Full\-time \| Senior leadership \| Reports to President**

Barbecues Galore is a specialty retailer with eight store locations and a growing e\-commerce business. We help customers explore barbecues, outdoor kitchens, patio furniture, fireplaces, accessories and related products through knowledgeable in\-store service and convenient online shopping.

We are looking for a Director of Marketing \& Digital Commerce to lead our entire marketing and e\-commerce operations. You will own the website and digital content, build our brand, bring more customers into our showrooms and grow profitable online revenue. This is a hands\-on leadership opportunity for someone who can turn strategy into measurable retail and digital sales results.

**Key Areas of Responsibility** 

· Retail traffic and sales: Create local and company\-wide campaigns that increase qualified visits and sales at all eight stores; lead local SEO, Google Business Profiles, geo\-targeted advertising, signage and store\-specific promotions.

· E\-commerce growth: Own online sales strategy, revenue targets, merchandising, customer acquisition, conversion, checkout improvements, average order value, retention and profitability.

· One connected customer journey: Make the website a powerful research and store\-visit tool as well as a high\-performing online shop; connect promotions, product information and customer experiences across channels.

· Website and digital content: Direct website strategy, design, navigation, mobile experience, development roadmap and optimization; maintain accurate product descriptions, specifications, pricing, imagery, videos, buying guides and landing pages.

· Marketing and brand: Lead brand positioning, seasonal campaigns, paid search and social, SEO, email, social content, creative production, product launches and customer loyalty initiatives.

· In\-store cooking demos and vendor events: Plan and schedule demonstrations across stores, delivered by our own teams and vendor representatives; coordinate products, staffing, logistics and promotion to generate attendance, engagement and sales.

· Team and partner leadership: Lead and develop marketing and e\-commerce employees; manage agencies, developers, vendors, projects and collaboration with store management, Purchasing, Operations and IT.

· Budgets, systems and results: Manage marketing budgets and digital tools; coordinate with IT on e\-commerce, CRM, inventory and POS integrations; track performance and improve marketing return on investment.

**How success will be measured**

Growth in store traffic and retail sales; profitable online revenue; website conversion and average order value; customer acquisition and retention; local search visibility; successful in\-store events; campaign return on investment; and strong team execution.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

**Required**

* Significant leadership experience in marketing, digital commerce, and retail\-related business operations.
* Demonstrated success developing marketing strategies that drive both physical store traffic and online sales.
* Strong understanding of omnichannel retail marketing and customer purchasing behavior.
* Experience managing e\-commerce platforms and delivering measurable online revenue growth.
* Proven ability to lead marketing teams, manage budgets, and oversee external agencies.
* Experience with website management, digital content, SEO, paid advertising, and analytics.
* Strong knowledge of digital customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and retention strategies.
* Experience planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect marketing initiatives to revenue and profitability.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and project management skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in multi\-location retail environments.
* Experience in specialty retail, home improvement, outdoor living, appliances, or other product\-focused retail categories.
* Experience with large online product catalogues and complex product information.
* Familiarity with retail point\-of\-sale, inventory, CRM, ERP, and e\-commerce integrations.
* Experience developing local store marketing programs alongside national or company\-wide campaigns.
* Experience managing seasonal retail promotional calendars.
* Demonstrated success leading website improvements and digital transformation projects.

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded marketing leader who understands that the ultimate objective of marketing is to generate profitable business growth.

This individual understands the importance of physical retail stores and recognizes that a strong digital presence should not only generate online sales but also bring more customers into our showrooms.

They will have the ability to develop a cohesive strategy across marketing, e\-commerce, and retail operations while maintaining strong attention to execution, detail, and measurable performance.

They will be comfortable leading a team, managing external partners, working closely with store management, overseeing website development, and making data\-driven decisions.

Most importantly, they will take ownership of results and demonstrate the ability to translate marketing strategy into increased store traffic, stronger online sales, and sustainable company growth.

Interested? Apply with your résumé and examples of measurable retail and/or e\-commerce growth you have led.

Pay: $110,000\.00\-$150,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Extended health care
* Life insurance
* On\-site parking
* Paid time off
* Store discount
* Vision care

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Leader, Enterprise - Americas
jobs.description:
Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI\-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year\-over\-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.


We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times *each,* clear evidence of strong product\-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3\-5 tools in a consolidation \& efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI\-leader in the recruiting space.


And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best\-in\-class recruiting product toward a multi\-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category\-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.


We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote\-first, high\-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise \& Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!


You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

**About this Role**
-------------------


TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B\+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing \& CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers \& Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways, and we are on track to do the same.


We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Leader in North America to lead the segment and scale our Enterprise AE team \- West (Mountain, Pacific, Central). There are three primary responsibilities that this sales leader will take on:

* **Own the revenue outcomes for the segment**, with clear accountability for delivering results. Partner with the senior AEs in a team selling motion to maximize our win rates on the company's largest opportunities. Manage deal risks and help navigate the complexities of large\-scale competitive replacement deals.
* **Build a high caliber team** in lock step with market demand. In general we believe that smaller, high caliber teams can achieve remarkable results. Your Enterprise team will be an adept group of solution selling experts.
* **Establish a reputation for excellence** by fostering alignment across Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering \& Professional Services creating a flywheel for future enterprise customer acquisition.


In this role, you’ll report to our Head of AMER Sales (Leigh Brown) and have significant impact in defining our go\-to\-market strategy and sales methodology. If we are even moderately successful relative to our ambition, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years!

**You could be a great fit if:**
================================

* You’ve led and scaled a team of SaaS Enterprise Account Executives delivering $5M/yr\+ at a company that has scaled beyond $100M ARR
* You have helped win $1M\+ SaaS deals with publicly traded companies, and can help your team see around corners on complex deals
* You have a proven track record of hiring and onboarding Ent AEs who can create their own pipeline and close both more tactical ($100k) and strategic ($500k\+) deals
* You have a strong mental model for enterprise sales execution. At the same time, you're a lifelong learner and are open to new ideas and experimentation.
* You build trusted relationships with customers and confidently facilitate peer\-to\-peer conversations between senior leaders to deepen partnerships and elevate strategic engagements.
* You become a product and industry expert. You connect the dots quickly. Customers and your team trust you to provide practical advice and relevant stories.
* You have successfully sold a complex multi\-product platform and have won competitive rip\-and\-replace sales motions.

**Bonus**
=========

* You have sold to Talent and/or People leaders and are familiar with their pains and priorities

**You shouldn't apply if:**
===========================

* You're a dashboard\-and\-forecast manager who doesn't like to get into the deals and daily operations
* You're not keen on learning our substantial product. "That's for SEs" isn't how we approach things here.

**Our Philosophy**
------------------


Here are a few key points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

* We have clear expectations about what it means to be a leader at Ashby
* We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team\-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals
* We believe in developing subject matter expertise (not just on our product but also the TA space broadly) which allows us to provide a differentiated buyer experience
* We continue to make material investments in engineering and product because we know at the end of the day, having the best product makes winning new customers easier
